Legal name, from the reference list or the filing.

description: Sector from the reference list. Not read from filings.

ABN, ACN or company number.
Share class and ISIN, for dual listings and code changes.

uk_source: Phrases in data/keywords.csv: "as announced on", "Further to its announcement on"

description: On-market, off-market, tender and so on.
The planned window. Updates can change the end date.
uk_source: Phrases in data/keywords.csv (programme_runs), e.g. "from X until Y", "will end no later than Y"

description: Announced size, in the currency stated. Never converted.
uk_source: Announcement text, e.g. up to £1.75 billion

description: Sum of the counts filings state as cancelled for this programme in the period. Appendix 3H buy-back cancellations, or a notice's reported count where there are none.
Total paid / total shares in the period in one currency. Blank if an amount or shares are missing or currencies are mixed.
Maximum number of shares, where stated.
The programme's broker: the latest one named.
Shares in issue as the newest notice states, excluding treasury.
uk_source: "have X ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares)"

description: Active until a completion notice is read (Reported). Shown Completed, marked Calculated with the reason, when the target is fully used or a later programme starts buying after this one's last purchase; that is worked out on display and not saved.
Cancelled or Treasury, with the notice's own words. Wording for both goes to review.

asx_source: Cancelled by law for sole-listed companies
nzx_source: "whether those shares are to be held as treasury stock"

description: True when the programme began before the earliest filing read, so its totals are partial.
Every change to size or dates, each with its filing. Today only the newest terms are kept.
The day the shares were bought.
The day the notice was filed. From the document; if it states none, from your list's Date column, else the purchase date, and the result says so.
Trading venue. When a notice has a venue table that adds up to the day's total, the day is split by venue; otherwise blank.
uk_source: Aggregate information or individual trades table

description: Shares bought that day (or at that venue).
uk_source: Aggregate number of ordinary shares purchased

description: Prices as written, in the unit stated. A unit attached to the number, such as 641.43p, is read.
uk_source: Volume weighted average / highest / lowest price paid per share

description: Unit of the prices, e.g. GBp for pence.
Amount paid that day, in the currency reported. Calculated as shares x average where the notice doesn't state it.
Reported (stated in the filing) or Calculated (worked out).
The broker named in the notice, its role (From, Through or Programme broker) and the sentence it came from. Blank when none is named.
For markets that report totals over a period (US, Japan, Canada). A UK or ASX day is a period of one day.

field: As of, total shares, total amount

What kind of filing it is within that form, named from data/filing_forms.csv.
